verdict.rationale: Numeral's pricing page claims it can 'Validate customer VAT IDs live', and the site says it handles global jurisdictions, so the core of B2B VAT ID checking is at least claimed. Nothing in the docs or API reference shows how validation works, which official registries it checks against, or whether reverse charge is applied automatically to B2B cross-border sales. missing for 10: API documentation of VAT/tax ID validation, evidence of checks against official registries (e.g. VIES), any reverse-charge handling in calculations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
